_meta.title: Root cause + fix for the electric ~14x under-emission
_meta.summary: NOT an hcl-mcp bug. This custom Radiance 6.1a build's compiled source_corr built-in drops the ies2rad brightdata A1 (candela-scale) multiplier, so IES luminaires under-emit by their candela scale (14.3711x for L09). hcl-mcp's electric pipeline is correct.

proof.A1_arg_10x_test: brightdata arg 14.3711 -> 143.711 gave IDENTICAL illuminance -> A1 ignored by source_corr
proof.fold_into_RGB_test: light RGB x14.3711 -> 420 lux nadir (= IES 1878 cd / 2.1^2 ~425) -> confirms A1 is the missing factor
proof.source_cal_override_test: shadowing source.cal with explicit flatcorr(v)=noneg(if(AC-.5,A1*v,v))/Rdot -> 420 lux -> the built-in source_corr is the culprit (local Radiance build issue)

grid_revalidation_office_room_4xL09.note: The ratio 14.36x is broken-vs-patched at the SAME rad_params (-ab 1 revalidation) and equals the ies2rad brightdata A1 scale (14.3711). (The original Task-4 run used the tool default -ab 2 and read avg 36.0 lux broken; ~5% higher due to the extra ambient bounce, still ~14x low.) Patched magnitudes (avg ~494 lux) are realistic for 4x4702 lm over 31.4 m^2 (well-lit office).

fix.do_not: Do NOT fold A1 into hcl-mcp's color_luminaire RGB -- that would DOUBLE-scale on a correct/stock Radiance whose source_corr applies A1.
fix.system_patch: Append explicit corr/flatcorr/boxcorr/lboxcorr/cylcorr overrides to /usr/local/radiance/lib/source.cal (later defs win). Requires sudo. Backup first. Revert = restore source.cal.hclbak.
fix.validated: The override yields correct magnitudes (avg 494 lux) via a RAYPATH-shadowed source.cal; the identical text applied to the system file makes the MCP electric tools correct.
